Class SwerveOffsetParams

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.swerve.SwerveOffsetParams
public final class SwerveOffsetParams extends Object
The swerve CANcoder magnet offsets as params, group swerve, so a module re-zeroed in the pit (SwerveAlignment) can be saved without a code change.

The offsets are per robot: they live in params/robots/<robot>/swerve.json, and each default is the offset in that robot's config class (FM2026 and so on). A missing or unreadable file, or a value out of bounds, leaves the config's offset.

Read once at boot, before the drivetrain is built, because CTRE writes each offset into its CANcoder's config when the drivetrain starts. A value changed later (tuning mode, disabled) does not reach the modules until the robot reboots, and an alert says so until then. Applying it live would take a blocking CANcoder config call and rebuilt module constants.
